Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the USA Under-19's reply. Bangladesh Under-19 are in a huddle near the ropes before they take their places on the field. It will be Bhavya Mehta to open the innings alongside Prannav Chettipalayam for USA Under-19. Md Iqbal Hasan Emon will start with the new ball. Off we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

On the other hand, USA Under-19 started off on a decent note and managed to pick up a wicket just at the end of the first Powerplay. They tried to put the pressure on the new batter but failed to get rid of him. However, they managed to get wickets late after the batters had set on the pitch. The fielding was also a mixed bag for the USA as they were a bit sloppy at the start but later on, they controlled their nerves and improved their performance. Arya Garg again had a good innings and picked up 3 wickets. He was suffering from a bit of cramp but he bounced back later in the innings. Aarin Nadkarni also managed to get 2 into his account. Parth Patel was exceptional out there in the field, taking two catches and also chipped in with a wicket. Ateendra Subramanian also picked up a wicket. The last ten overs were a bit expensive and it is a tough job for the USA batters to chase. Will they rise to the challenge? We shall find out.

Aarin Nadkarni is in for a chat. He says that it was a great experience to play his first game of the World Cup. Mentions that the wicket was doing a bit early on and wanted to make good use of it. Credits his teammates for their efforts in the field. Ends by saying that he backs his batters to get the job done.

A good finish to the innings for Bangladesh Under-19 and they will be happy with what they have got on the board. The patience has worked for the Bangla Tigers to put up a huge target on board to challenge the opposition's batters. Their batters played the majority of their innings at a slow pace, but they were rotating their strike and made sure that the scoreboard kept ticking. Their top-order batters were able to make a decent start to the innings. They made wealthy partnerships but none of those were looking dangerous or creating havoc problems for their opposition. Ariful Islam had a calm and composed knock by scoring a half-century partnering with Ahrar Amin. They were brilliant in terms of communicating with each other for running between the wickets. They had a partnership of 122 runs and anchored the innings exceptionally. The partnership broke with the dismissal of Ahrar as he fell 6 runs short of a half-century. But Ariful carried on and, scored a century. Md Shihab James also had a short cameo to stretch the score towards 300. But the lower middle order did just enough to put up 291 runs on the board.

Commentary.Commentary: We are done with the pre-game formalities! Out come the two umpires as they make their way out to the centre. The skipper of USA Under-19, Rishi Ramesh leads his troops out to the middle and they are joined by the two openers of Bangladesh Under-19, Ashiqur Rahman Shibli and Adil Bin Siddik. We are nearing the start of the penultimate game in Group A but before we get underway, the match officials and the players will line up for the national anthems. It will be Bangladesh's national anthem first followed by the national anthem of the USA.

PITCH REPORT - WV Raman is near the deck. He starts by saying that it is a bright and sunny morning here in Bloemfontein without much breeze. Informs that pitch number 4 will be used for this game and the short boundaries are short as compared to the straight boundary. Mentions that there is a bit of grass and the pacers will relish bowling on this surface. Further adds that the wicket is a dry and hard, meaning that there are runs to be had here and spinners will come into play in the afternoon.

The skipper of Bangladesh Under-19, Mahfuzur Rahman says that he is happy to lose the toss as he wanted to bat first. He reckons that his batters are in good shape and will try to set a big total. Ends up saying that they have made one change with Md Iqbal Hasan Emon coming in for Md Rohanat Doullah Borson.

The captain of USA Under-19, Rishi Ramesh says that they will bowl first. Mentions that they wanted to bowl first in the last game as well because most teams are benefiting from bowling first in these conditions. Adds that there is a little bit of grass on this wicket. States that they got a lot of practice in the last week and they are looking forward to this game. Informs that they have made changes with Bhavya Mehta coming in for Aryaman Suri and Rayaan Bhagani makes way for Aarin Nadkarni.

TOSS - USA Under-19 have won the toss and they will BOWL first.

On the other hand, USA Under-19 also failed to win the opening game against Ireland. It was a really disappointing effort from their batting unit in the opening game. Except for Khush Bhalala, no one was able to surpass the 15-run mark which tells you a lot about their performance. Arya Garg will be one to watch out for as he looked dangerous with the new ball. Will the USA win their first match and make things difficult for Bangladesh? Let's find out! Toss and team news in a bit.

Bangladesh Under-19 started their campaign with a defeat against India but they made their comeback against Ireland with a comprehensive victory. Md Shihab James is the star player from the batting unit knocking back-to-back half-centuries for his team. Maruf Mridha will lead the bowling attack and he will be hoping to continue the good work.

The ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup is in full swing, and the Mangaung Oval at Bloemfontein is set to host an intriguing Match 17 between USA U-19 and Bangladesh U-19 in Pool A. Bangladesh U-19 has had a mixed run in the tournament, experiencing a comprehensive defeat against India by 84 runs but bouncing back with a fabulous 6-wicket win over Ireland U-19. Mohammad Shihab James has been their standout performer, scoring consecutive fifties, including a crucial one in the victory against Ireland. Ashiqur Shibli and Ahrah Amin have also made valuable contributions with the bat, showcasing a strong batting lineup that aims to continue its form in the upcoming game. The middle-order batters have shown promise, and the bowling pack, led by Maruf Mridha and skipper Rahman Rabby, has been consistent in picking up wickets. On the other hand, USA U-19 faced a setback in their first match against Ireland U-19 and are eager for a comeback. In their last game, they struggled to post a competitive total, being bundled out for a meager 105 with no substantial contributions from any batter. Aryan Garg did manage to strike early with a couple of wickets, but the score was not enough to challenge the Irish batters, resulting in a significant loss. As they face Bangladesh U-19, the focus for USA U-19 will be on playing the full 50 overs and establishing partnerships in the batting department. Captain Rishi Ramesh and his team need to step up to present a formidable challenge. The stage is set for an exciting clash.
